summary: Auddia Inc. filed an 8-K on November 6, 2026, disclosing Warrant Exchange Agreements with holders of its publicly traded and privately placed warrants, executed under Section 3(a)(9) to avoid registration. Each Existing Warrant converts into two common shares: initially 580,023 warrants exchange for 1,160,045 shares, with a further 4,135,539 warrants for 8,271,077 shares conditioned on stockholder approval. No commission or remuneration is paid. This is a warrant-inducement recapitalization rather than a conventional M&A event; watch dilution, Nasdaq approval timing, and any Nasdaq minimum-price or stockholder-approval constraints.
